meta.rung1_classification: RADIAL_INWARD_GEOMETRIC_ORACLE -- the rung-1 family shifted the fire-instant position too, so the transition was never simulated (case A)
meta.dynamic_family: nominal acceleration + bounded radial correction, semi-implicit Euler from the TRUE fire-instant state
meta.shared_rule: delta = clip(lane_clearance_at_fire - LANE_RESERVE, 0, DELTA_MAX); no witness name and no escape result enters it
meta.lane_reserve_note: LANE-specific; the 10 mm budget from 1L/1M covers ATTACKER-LIMITER relative distance and is not reused
meta.rule_snapping: the rule value is continuous; it is snapped DOWN to the largest gate-valid grid delta at or below it, because the raw value can land on an unevaluated and gate-invalid delta

failure_classes.A_NEAR_TERMINAL_RAZOR_GAP: cm-scale leak at the terminal ring
